property_summary: For every caller address, calling NETM() as the contract owner (msg.sender == owner) always sets balances[owner] to totalDistributed in the reference; the mutant inverts onlyOwner so the real owner cannot perform NETM and thus there exist callers for which balances differ after NETM is invoked.
change_summary: onlyOwner modifier condition inverted to deny the real owner and allow others, changing which callers can invoke NETM and thus who can cause balances changes.
